{"compatibility":"major","safety_note_md":"# SafeStan Safety Note

Compatibility: major.

Protected data: `y` is the directly observed continuous variable in the original sampling statement. The censored contribution is encoded through `N_censored` and `U` in a manual CCDF target increment rather than as a SafeStan protected sampling statement.

Generated files: none.

Reason: the model uses `target += N_censored * normal_lccdf(U | mu, 1)`, which SafeStan forbids. In addition, the parameter `mu` has no explicit built-in prior; adding one would change the posterior because the original uses an improper flat prior. A same-density SafeStan translation would require a substantive rewrite of the censored likelihood and/or a change to the parameter prior discipline, so no minor-compatible rewrite is emitted.
","model_safe_stan":"","data_safe_json":"","protected_variables":[]}

data_safe_json.description: Valid JSON object text for data_safe.json, or empty string for major rewrites.
